data.summary: The only unbeaten Singles player usually wins. An event with too few rounds to find a sole unbeaten player, or one that needs places for the remaining field, can use these criteria in sequence. First, compare win, loss and draw records. Second, use strength of schedule based on the records of opponents. Third, use total Victory points (VP). In Warhammer 40,000, an individual game’s VP and VP margin can obscure how close it was. A strong opponent can hold the score down, and army matchups can distort the margin. Use VP as a final tiebreaker or when a large field needs a finer ranking. Strength of schedule distinguishes the difficulty of two equal records.
